name: editor-toolbar-dock

frames.best_why: The dock rests at the bottom with the shapes flyout open above it, showing icons, labels and shortcuts at once.

tagline: A tiny icon toolbar hops between the edges of a dark canvas.
summary: A compact design-tool dock on a dark canvas: a grip plus six line icons, the active one sitting on a white sliding plate. Tools show labels, grouped tools open flyouts, and the strip can be dragged to another edge.
appearance: A near-black bordered canvas holds a short white rounded strip near its bottom edge, made of a small grip and six dark line icons. The chosen tool sits on a white rounded plate, and a small white menu of tool names can open above it.
behaviour: The white plate slides from icon to icon as tools are picked. Hovering shows a label with a shortcut, and pressing the corner of a grouped tool opens its flyout; dragging the grip carries the dock across the canvas and it snaps to the nearest edge, turning vertical on the sides.
demo_content: Icons for select, hand, shapes, pen, text and comment; the Shapes menu lists Rectangle, Ellipse and Line.
search_phrases: toolbar that snaps to screen edges
use_when: A canvas or editor app needs a compact tool switcher that can be thrown out of the way.
avoid_when: It assumes a mouse-driven, sized canvas; edge throwing is awkward on touch and icon meaning needs a hover.
customise: Pass a tools array of ids, labels, icons, shortcuts and nested sub-tools. The starting edge, shortcut scope, label and class names are props; plate springs and tooltip timing live in the source.
weight_why: A few animated buttons plus a layout spring that settles to a stop when untouched.

a11y.note: Roving focus, single-key shortcuts and menu arrow keys are handled; every button carries a label and pressed state.

issues: Inactive tool icons are dark grey on the near-black canvas and barely visible at rest.
The demo shows the dock very small inside a large empty canvas, so its scale is hard to judge.
polish_why: Precise motion and a tidy dock; dim inactive icons hurt usability on the dark canvas.
